titulo: Case Report: Dasatinib-associated chylothorax and occult Bartonella henselae infection in pediatric leukemia: a case report and systematic review

fig.label: FIGURE 3
fig.caption: Corresponding computed tomography (CT) findings before and after treatment for chylothorax. (A) Chest CT with mediastinal window showing bilateral chylothorax before treatment (Day 1). (B) Follow-up chest CT with mediastinal window showing near-complete resolution of pleural effusion and lung re-expansion (Day 16).
